description: Cresto Techno Limited engages in the production, marketing, and distribution of entertainment content. The company produces and acquires entertainment content across multiple formats and genres through in-house production or outright purchase, and also aggregates content from third-party partners on a revenue-share basis. It distributes and syndicates content across digital platforms, satellite channels, cinema theatres, and airborne platforms. The company builds and manages communities across digital platforms and social media channels covering music, food, wellness, and devotional genres, and monetizes content produced by creators across publishing mediums. It also engages in the co-production of feature films and series, including Telugu-language films. The company serves audiences in India and international markets. Cresto Techno Limited was formerly known as Silly Monks Entertainment Limited and changed its name to Cresto Techno Limited in September 2026. Cresto Techno Limited was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
